== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Sabotage (Japanese)|Sabotage]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67673 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(50, 16, 430, 612)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>b0a05576040f214f6dd797f3bb386a62add45bb09327ab2590cd5b473d29ffae</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-2/27/Japanese-ANH-Sabotage-SWCA-67673.jpg Internet Archive item].
